title: Silver & Bronze Medals
highlight: 35,000+ participants from 90+ countries
description: Abrar Abir, with teammate Emtenan Kabir of Team SAPH.Ai, earned Silver and Bronze Medals at the 26th International Robot Olympiad in Busan, South Korea, by solving local water infrastructure challenges. Competing against a massive field of over 35,000 participants from 90+ countries, they designed and developed robotic systems to clean urban waste and reduce marine pollution in Busan. The solution received formal recognition from the Mayor of Busan and was positively considered for future implementation.

title: Best Startup Award
highlight: Top innovators among 70,000+ competitors from 95 nations
description: Abrar Abir co-led Team SAPH.Ai with A Z M Emtenan Kabir to win the prestigious "Startup Idea Award" at the World Robot Olympiad OC in Manila, Philippines, making Bangladesh proud. Ranking among the top innovators out of 70,000+ competitors from 95 nations, the team was recognised for researching and engineering a pneumatic soft robot with real-world entrepreneurial potential for rescue missions and underground exploration. Their problem-solving approach earned international recognition and marks the highest honour Bangladesh has received to date in this category at the World Robot Olympiad, in line with SAPH.Ai's mission of turning creative ideas into impactful innovations.

title: Global Top 10
highlight: Top 10 of 75 global teams
description: Abrar Abir ranked in the Top 10 among 75 international teams at the NASA Human Exploration Rover Challenge, an Artemis-affiliated competition. He designed, presented and piloted a lunar rover, showcasing engineering innovation, mechanical design skills and space-exploration problem solving.

title: Research Seed Fund Winner
highlight: Polluted water tested and treated in 20 coastal villages
description: Spearheading SAPH.Ai, Abrar Abir and Emtenan Kabir were selected as the Seed Fund Winner at the Stockholm Junior Water Prize, competing among distinguished participants from 60+ countries. Supported by the Swedish Government and global organisations such as WaterAid, they developed an innovative research project focused on detecting water pollution, addressing critical sustainability and environmental challenges. They engineered an AI model inside a modular device that tests water contamination cheaply and instantly and treats the water on the spot, successfully testing and treating polluted water across 20 coastal villages.

title: Gold Medal
highlight: Top among 45K+ competitors nationwide
description: Abrar Abir won a Gold Medal at the Bangladesh National Mathematical Olympiad, the selection round for the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO), ranking first nationally among 45,000+ competitors.

title: Mentored - 3rd Prize
highlight: Stood out among 252 international teams
description: Mentored by Abrar Abir, who shaped the core idea behind the project, SAPH.Ai members Musarrat Mahjabin and Turabi Meherin Sokal secured 3rd Prize at the prestigious 16th e-ICON World Contest in Seoul, South Korea. Hosted by the Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea, this global AI and software competition challenges young innovators to build web applications that address the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Standing out among 252 international teams, Team MonAndo earned the fully funded honour of representing Bangladesh in the international final with MonAndo, an AI-powered mental wellness web app offering free, localised Virtual Reality Exposure Therapy (VRET) designed for underprivileged youth.

title: Mentored - Bronze Medal
highlight: Aerospace robotics on the global stage
description: Mentored by Abrar Abir, whose concept the project was built on, SAPH.Ai member Khondokar Mushfiqul Islam represented Bangladesh and brought home a Bronze Medal at the International Robot Olympiad (IRO) in Gold Coast, Australia. Competing in aerospace robotics on the global stage, he designed and built a satellite maintenance robot that floats and carries out tasks in outer space using AI computer vision.

title: National Winner
event: World Robot Olympiad Bangladesh Open Championship
highlight: Earned Bangladesh's place at WRO Asia & Pacific
description: As Team Leader and Mechanical & Technical Lead of Team SAPH.Ai, Abrar Abir, with Emtenan Kabir (Programming & Software Lead), won the National Round of the WRO Bangladesh Open Championship 2025, earning the honour of representing Bangladesh at the World Robot Olympiad Open Championship – Asia & Pacific in the Philippines. Before this, Abrar secured the winner's medal at the Dhaka Regional Round, which first earned the team its place at the WRO Bangladesh Nationals.

title: National Winner
highlight: Crowned winners of the national round
description: Abrar Abir and Emtenan Kabir, the primary duo behind Team SAPH.Ai, were officially crowned Winners at the 7th Bangladesh Robot Olympiad National Round, showing exceptional technical mastery.

title: Gold Medal
highlight: Went on to represent Bangladesh in Dubai
description: Abrar Abir and Emtenan Kabir won a Gold Medal in the National Round, earning the chance to represent Bangladesh internationally at the Codeavour: AI & Coding Competition in Dubai. They developed a 6-Wheeler Pipeline Inspection Robot, a specialised subsystem of their AI-Assisted Drainage & Sewage Maintenance project. Using Artificial Intelligence and a rugged 6-wheel drive, the robot autonomously navigates dangerous underground sewage pipelines to find blockages, detect explosive gases such as methane (CH4) and carry out targeted cleaning without risking human lives.

title: Honour of Recognition
event: Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology
highlight: Recognised by the Government of Bangladesh
description: SAPH.Ai, founded and led by Abrar Abir, received the Honour of Recognition Award from the Government's Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology, a formal recognition of the team's significant contributions to the country's fast-growing tech sector.

title: Mentored - Honour of Excellence
highlight: Presented by Governor Dr. Ahsan H. Mansur
description: Emtenan Kabir of SAPH.Ai was formally honoured for his excellence by Dr. Ahsan H. Mansur, the Governor of Bangladesh Bank. The recognition celebrated work mentored by Abrar Abir as SAPH.Ai's founder and built on ideas he originated, marking a proud moment for the entire SAPH.Ai team to cherish.

title: 2nd Runner-Up
highlight: AI sewer robot built with OpenCV and TensorFlow
description: Abrar Abir, Emtenan Kabir and Sonoth Amin, the minds steering SAPH.Ai, claimed 2nd Runner-Up at Bangladesh's National STEAM Olympiad with their project Subterranean Sanitizers. To tackle Bangladesh's sanitation crisis and end hazardous manual labour, they designed an AI-Assisted Drainage and Sewage Maintenance Bot using OpenCV and TensorFlow. The robot autonomously navigates sewers, detects debris and mitigates dangerous gases, offering a safer, far more efficient alternative to inhuman working conditions.

title: Top 20 Teams
event: BCSIR National Science and Industrial Technology Fair
highlight: Wide media coverage in the national round
description: SAPH.Ai Founder Abrar Abir and Co-founder Emtenan Kabir were recognised as one of the Top 20 teams at the BCSIR National Science and Industrial Technology Fair 2024, drawing substantial media attention in the National Round. They showcased their AI-Assisted Drainage and Sewage Maintenance Bot, engineered with OpenCV and TensorFlow: an autonomous robot that navigates sewers, detects debris and mitigates dangerous gases to help solve Bangladesh's sanitation crisis and end hazardous manual cleaning.

title: 3rd Place & Championships as Mentor
highlight: Champions at Upazila, District and Division levels
description: Mentored by Abrar Abir, who originated the project's core idea, and guided by SAPH.Ai founders Abrar Abir and Emtenan Kabir, Team SAPH.Ai represented Bagerhat at the 47th National Science and Technology Week after winning championship titles at the Upazila, District and Division levels, and also took 3rd Place in the Project Presentation category at the BAFSD Science Fair. The team of Talukdar Ahanaf Nafi, Ahmad Al Abid, Talukder Mahir Aronno and Talukder Tanzim Sayad, supervised by their teacher Biddut Kumar Mondol Sir, showcased Symmetrical Holonomic Locomotion for Isotropic Hazard Traversal: a smart disaster-response system that navigates hazardous environments, detects dangers and collects real-time data from unsafe areas, showing how locally built robotics can make emergency rescue faster, safer and more effective for humanitarian response in Bangladesh.

title: Champion, IT Project Display
event: 15th DRMC National Science & Codeavour International Carnival
highlight: Champion in the IT Project Display segment
description: Abrar Abir and Emtenan Kabir of Team SAPH.Ai were crowned Champion in the IT Project Display segment at the 15th DRMC National Science & Codeavour 1.0 International Carnival 2024. They exhibited their 6-Wheeler Pipeline Inspection Robot, an AI-driven subsystem with a rugged 6-wheel drive built to tackle dangerous underground sewage lines by autonomously finding blockages, detecting explosive gases such as methane (CH4) and performing targeted cleaning.

title: First Position, Research Paper
highlight: Best research paper of the fest
description: At the 7th Rajshahi College National Science Fest, the research paper by Abrar Abir and Team SAPH.Ai took First Position. The paper detailed their AI-Assisted Drainage and Sewage Maintenance Bot, a robot engineered with OpenCV and TensorFlow to tackle Bangladesh's sanitation crisis by autonomously navigating sewers, detecting debris and mitigating dangerous gases.

title: Champion
highlight: Hosted by the Tejgaon College Science Club
description: Abrar Abir, with Emtenan and Siam of Team SAPH.Ai, emerged as Champion at TCSC Science Fiesta 1.0, hosted by the Tejgaon College Science Club. They presented the 6-Wheeler Pipeline Inspection Robot, which uses Artificial Intelligence and a rugged 6-wheel drive to autonomously navigate hazardous underground pipelines, clear blockages and detect explosive methane (CH4) gas.

title: 1st Runner-Up
highlight: Hosted by the Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman Novotheatre
description: Abrar Abir and Emtenan Kabir of Team SAPH.Ai won 1st Runner-Up at the Astro Boishakhi Mela 1431, hosted by the Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman Novotheatre to celebrate Bangla New Year 1431. They were awarded for their AI-Assisted Drainage and Sewage Maintenance Bot, an OpenCV and TensorFlow-powered system that autonomously navigates sewers to detect debris and mitigate dangerous gases, a safe alternative to inhuman manual cleaning.

title: Champion, Project Display
highlight: SAPH.Ai's very first championship
description: Abrar Abir and Emtenan Kabir won Team SAPH.Ai's very first Champion title, in the Project Display category at the 5th BAFSD National Science Festival 2023. They designed an AI-Assisted Drainage and Sewage Maintenance Bot using OpenCV and TensorFlow that autonomously navigates sewers, detects debris and mitigates dangerous gases, replacing dangerous manual labour with a safer, more efficient answer to the local sanitation crisis.
